entry.name: source
entry.label: Where the status comes from: "ollama" (an Ollama server's API) or "dashboard" (a Mac server dashboard's /api/status)

entry.name: ollamaUrl
entry.label: Address of the Ollama server

entry.name: dashboardUrl
entry.label: Address of the Mac server dashboard (its /api/status is read)

entry.name: showGpu
entry.label: Read the GPU load on this computer (NVIDIA through nvidia-smi, or AMD); Ollama source only

entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: Seconds between status checks

entry.name: showStatusInPanel
entry.label: Show the status badge (GPU load, coloured by server state)

entry.name: showLoadedInPanel
entry.label: Show the loaded models badge

entry.name: showZeroInPanel
entry.label: Show the loaded models badge even with no model loaded

entry.name: notifyOnDown
entry.label: Send a notification when an LLM server goes down

entry.name: collapsedGroups
entry.label: Groups collapsed in the popup

entry.name: useSharedLook
entry.label: Follow the shared look (same for all madebypless widgets) instead of this widget's own appearance settings, once a shared look has been saved

entry.name: showLogo
entry.label: Show a logo in front of the badges in the panel

entry.name: logoIcon
entry.label: Icon name or image file for the logo; empty means the widget's own icon

entry.name: badgeSpacing
entry.label: Gap in pixels between the logo and the badges

entry.name: logoSpacing
entry.label: Extra gap in pixels between the logo and the first badge

entry.name: badgeStyle
entry.label: Panel style: square badges, rounded badges, or an icon with a status dot

entry.name: colorDown
entry.label: Colour of the status badge while a server is down

entry.name: colorBusy
entry.label: Colour of the status badge while the GPU is busy

entry.name: colorIdle
entry.label: Colour of the status badge while the servers are up and the GPU is idle

entry.name: colorLoaded
entry.label: Colour of the loaded models badge

entry.name: colorCountBackground
entry.label: Count background badge colour
